summary: Round 1's major finding is resolved. The refactor extracts the repaint/live source decision into a standalone, gocui-independent function, selectLogtail(p renderParams, read logtailReader), called from renderFrame's case stat.CollectLogtail with a thunk that carries everything needing g/v (readLogfileRecent's view geometry, v.Clear(), Reopen's DB round-trip, the printCmdline error write, the Size bookkeeping). I re-ran my round-1 mutation myself: 'if !p.fromFile {' -> 'if false {' now fails exactly the two tests claimed (Test_selectLogtail_repaintNeverInvokesTheRead, Test_repaintLogtail_noFileAccess); inverting to 'if p.fromFile {' fails all four selectLogtail/repaint tests, as claimed. I also independently tried the specific hole the coordinator asked about — a selectLogtail that returns the params pair unconditionally on BOTH paths, never invoking read at all — and confirmed it is caught by Test_selectLogtail_livePathReadsTheFile and Test_selectLogtail_livePathPropagatesReadError (both fail), so Test_selectLogtail_repaintNeverInvokesTheRead cannot be satisfied by a selection that is simply broken for the live panel. I spot-checked one round-1 mutation (publishFrame ignoring p.publish) and it still reddens Test_frameStore_publishOnlyOnLivePath, confirming no coverage was lost. printLogtail/renderLogtail are byte-for-byte untouched by this commit (diff confirms zero changes to either function); both the live and repaint branches of renderFrame now converge on one printLogtail(v, path, buf) call instead of two, which is a safe consolidation given the underlying function did not change. The round-1 minor (redundant byte-exactness assertion) is also resolved: the exact-match assertion was dropped from Test_repaintLogtail_noFileAccess, and the remaining assertions (path/buf equal the stored pair, not the adversary's; NotContains on rendered output) discriminate on selectLogtail's decision using a thunk that genuinely reads the adversary file, not a dead fixture. Only top/stat.go and top/stat_test.go were touched; top/pause.go and top/pause_test.go have zero diff in this commit, and the only deletion is the old body of the one rewritten test. All mutations were reverted; tree is clean.
